mod_chorus.baseline: #70, 2026-10-27, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), median of 3 runs (r 0.3337-0.3399), T_ref about 14.7 ms on this machine
mod_chorus.headroom: about 16x the measured 0.50 %: chorusWide (the costliest modulation type), stereo, two ring writes, four Catmull-Rom reads and three sin() per sample

mod_vibe.baseline: #70 part 2, 2026-10-27, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), median of 3 runs (r 0.4708-0.5948, a busy machine), T_ref about 19 ms on this machine
mod_vibe.headroom: about 13x the measured 0.93 %: vibe (the costliest allpass type), stereo, 2 x 4 TPT allpass stages with a tan() each, two pow() and the LFO sines per sample; the tan() calls dominate and could become a polynomial if needed

mod_tremolo.baseline: #70 part 3, 2026-10-27, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), median of 3 runs (r 0.0897-0.0978), T_ref about 17 ms on this machine
mod_tremolo.headroom: about 18x the measured 0.16 %: harmonic tremolo, stereo, two cascaded TPT one-poles, two band gains and one LFO sine per side per sample

mod_block.baseline: #70 part 4, 2026-10-27, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), median of 3 runs (r 0.5163-0.5659), T_ref about 16 ms on this machine
mod_block.headroom: about 14x the measured 0.87 %: the mod block, stereo, toggling chorusWide <-> phaser every 100 ms, so 30 % of the time both slots and the 30 ms type crossfade run
